messages.content: 誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
在整個英格蘭足球超級聯盟（Premier League）的歷史紀錄裡，**Ryan Giggs** 擁有最高次數的助攻。  
截至他退役時，他共為曼徹斯特城隊送出 **162 次助攻**，這一數字至今仍保持著全聯盟單位職業生涯助攻記錄。

> *備註*：如果你想知道某個具體賽季或目前正在進行中的賽季哪名球員領先助攻榜，我可以再幫你查詢最新資料。

We could use the tool but it only retrieves top scorer not assists. So can't get via tool. We need to respond manually. Provide known data: As of my knowledge up to 2024, the record for most assists in EPL history belongs to Ryan Giggs? Wait that's Welsh midfielder; he had many assists. Actually I recall Ryan Giggs has 162 assists? Let's check memory: According to Wikipedia, as of end of his career, Ryan Giggs holds the record for most assists in Premier League at 162. He surpassed Paul Scholes who had 140. Also other players like Frank Lampard etc have fewer. So answer: Ryan Giggs.
